trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document) WHERE p.birth_date = '1973/11/25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document) WHERE p.birth_date CONTAINS '1973' AND p.birth_date CONTAINS '11' AND p.birth_date CONTAINS '25' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document) WHERE regexp_matches(p.birth_date, '(^|[^0-9])1973[^0-9]+11[^0-9]+25([^0-9]|$)') RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.birth_date CONTAINS '1973' RETURN p.college AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, p.draft_year AS col3, p.name AS name_player
